notes.title: Notice Regarding Upcoming Changes on MAR 4 and MAR 18
notes.notes:
Please be informed of the following changes that will occur after the maintenances on Tuesday, MAR 4 and MAR 18 2025 UTC.

Content

▣ Aeterna

 After the maintenance on Tuesday, MAR 4, 2025, the Aeterna channel will be removed, and gameplay will no longer be possible.
 All episode quests available in the Aeterna region will be deleted.
 Items previously obtainable in Aeterna will no longer be available or usable, including:

 Level achievement rewards
 Crafting and material items from Aeterna
 Mission rewards
 Aeterna-exclusive Monster Collection and Equipment Book rewards
 Consumables and equipment sold at Antana Port
 Exploration Level EXP capsules

 During the MAR 4 maintenance, Aeterna-exclusive materials and consumables will be removed.
 Achievements that reward creatures, emoticons, and Silver Amplification Grimoire will remain


▣ Exceed

 Exceed content will be discontinued, and new content will be introduced in an upcoming Sunken Depths update.
 From Saturday, MAR 1, 2025, 09:00 UTC, Exceed will no longer be playable.
 The Exceed channel will remain accessible for collecting FEB play rewards.
 The Exceed channel will be removed at a later date. Please collect your FEB play rewards before the channel is deleted.


▣ Master Kaleido Box

 For Sunken Depths equipment, its rarity will change while maintaining its equipment grade when converted through the Armory or using the Promotion system.
 As a result, the four existing Master Kaleido Box types will be merged into one.
 On Tuesday, MAR 18, 2025, the Master Kaleido Box sold at NPC Seria’s shop will be updated.
 Sales of the current four Master Kaleido Boxes (Rare, Unique, Legendary, and Epic) will be discontinued.
 A new Master Kaleido Box will be added as a purchasable item for 20 Kaleido Boxes.
 Existing Master Kaleido Boxes will remain usable on equipment up to Lv. 110 and can be refunded through NPC Seria.
 A refund tab will be added to NPC Seria’s shop, where refund pots for the four Kaleido Box types will be available.


▣ Transcendent Stone

 Due to the Sunken Depths equipment system changes, the existing Transcendent Stone and One-Shot Transcendent Stone for equipment will be adjusted as follows:

 Both stones will be limited to use on equipment up to Lv. 110.
 On Tuesday, MAR 4, 2025, equipment Transcendent Stone sales will be discontinued in the CERA Shop.
 Details on the new Sunken Depths equipment Transcendent system will be announced in a future update notice.



▣ Codename: Gaebolg

 The Codename: Gaebolg content will be removed with the Sunken Depths update.
 On Tuesday, MAR 18, 2025, the Codename: Gaebolg channel will be deleted, and gameplay will no longer be possible.
 Resources related to Insignia upgrade and reinforcement will be transferred to the new Sunken Depths dungeons.
 Monster Fragments used in the Codename: Gaebolg Monster Collection will no longer be obtainable.
 Players who wish to claim Codename: Gaebolg Monster Collection rewards should do so before MAR 18.


▣ Noblesse Code

 The Noblesse Code content will be removed with the Sunken Depths update.
 On Tuesday, MAR 18, 2025, the Noblesse Code channel will be deleted, and gameplay will no longer be possible.
 Noblesse Code entry tickets will become unusable.
 Players who wish to use their Noblesse Code entry tickets must do so before MAR 18.


▣ Arad Adventure

 The Arad Adventure content within the Explorer Club will be removed with the Sunken Depths update.
 All Adventure Rubies and Mercenary Recruitment Tickets purchased from the CERA Shop and Mileage Shop will be extracted and compensated with Remy’s Shining Touch.
 Each purchased Adventure Ruby or Mercenary Recruitment Ticket will be exchanged for 1 Remy’s Shining Touch.
 Adventure Rubies obtained through gameplay will not be compensated.
 All purchased Adventure Rubies and Mercenary Recruitment Tickets will be exchanged regardless of whether they were used.
 The exact compensation schedule will be announced in a future notice.


▣ White Ocean Coin Shop / Records of Shining Adventure Shop

 The White Ocean Coin Shop will be available until MAR 18, 2025, and the Records of Shining Adventure Shop will be available until APR 1, 2025.
 On Tuesday, FEB 11, 2025, a deletion date will be added for White Ocean Coins and Records of Shining Adventures.

 White Ocean Coins will be deleted on MAR 18, 2025, at 09:00 UTC.
 Records of Shining Adventures will be deleted on APR 1, 2025, at 09:00 UTC.

 On MAR 18, 2025, NPC Elieve’s White Ocean Coin Shop will be removed.
 On APR 1, 2025, NPC Elieve’s Records of Shining Adventure Shop will be removed.
 On MAR 18, 2025, NPC Elieve will be removed from Seria’s room.

 After the MAR 18 maintenance, the Records of Shining Adventure Shop will still be accessible via NPC Elieve in Clearmist Plaza.

※ White Ocean Coins can be obtained until MAR 18, 2025, before they are deleted. Please use them before removal.


Thank you.

- Dungeon Fighter Online Support Team

notes.title: Update Regarding Recovery Support Policy
notes.notes:
Greetings Adventurers,

Please be informed of the following updates/changes regarding our Recovery Support Policy which will be effective as of the FEB 20, 2024 update.


1. Users will now be eligible for up to 5 recoveries per year per account. 
- Previously: One recovery per account
(Yearly cycle will be based on the date of an account's first recovery request)

2. Recovery will only be available for requests made within the following time period.
- Items: Within 3 days of the time of incident.
- Character Deletion: Within 25 days of the time of character deletion.

3. Support will now be available for the following cases.

 Custom Option transfer
 Option growth
 Enchants - Enchants will now be restored to recovered items where possible


Please note that although we will strive to provide as much assistance in as various cases as possible, recovery may still be limited in some cases.

The following limitations may be applied when applying for recovery.

 Some aspects of items may not be recovered if they include probability-based features 
 (e.g. Reinforcement, amplification, etc.)
Recovery requests made for mistakes that occurred in spite of system safety measures may be denied. (e.g. Typing in confirmation text.)
Materials/resulting items from the incident must be in possession in order for recovery to be processed (e.g. Character must possess the corresponding amount of Epic Souls to be deleted in order for equipment to be recovered after a disassemblement mistake.)
Consumable/materials used during the process of a mistake may not be returned upon item recovery.
Restrictions to items issued may be added (e.g. Tradable items may be recovered as account-bound/untradable


As we offer recovery support on a case-by-case basis, please send us a ticket and our support team will let you know if we can assist you in any way possible if you're unsure as to whether your case is eligible for recovery.

You can check out additional details regarding recovery requests through our FAQs.

We hope these changes will better help our Adventurers on their adventures in spite of any honest mistakes that might be made on the way!


Thank you.

- Dungeon Fighter Online Support Team
